t: This is the memorial to Arthur Sullivan, in Victoria Embankment Gardens. It was made by the Welsh sculptor William Goscombe John, who was known for his many public memorials. It has been a Grade II listed structure since 1958. Sullivan was the composer behind fourteen comic operas with W. S. Gilbert, among them H.M.S. Pinafore, The Pirates of Penzance and The Mikado. He also wrote the hymn Onward, Christian Soldiers and the song The Lost Chord.
